mapper.sql: id, uuid, external_id, transport_type, endpoint_url, tools, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mcp_tool_catalogs ( external_id, transport_type, endpoint_url, tools, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.TransportType}, #{params.EndpointURL,sensitive=true}, CAST(#{params.Tools} AS jsonb), NOW(), NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (transport_type, endpoint_url) DO UPDATE SET tools = excluded.tools, updated_at = NOW() RETURNING
